narration.text: Is AI making your kids smarter? Some wealthy parents think so. We dive into today's top AI news.

The Verge reports some wealthy American families are now turning to AI to teach their children. They are choosing AI over traditional schools. This shows a growing, albeit specific, trust in AI education.
TechCrunch reveals Midjourney is in a legal dispute with Hollywood studios. Midjourney wants these studios to disclose their own AI usage. This highlights rising tensions in creative industries.

TechCrunch also reports that Alibaba has reportedly banned its employees from using Claude Code. The company has classified this as high-risk software. This indicates corporate concerns over AI tool security.
Finally, The Verge covers a new conflict within the fanfiction community. Authors are trying to root out AI-generated works. Detection methods are causing controversy and division.
That's your AI news brief for today. Tell us which story interests you most in the comments. And follow us for tomorrow's AI updates.

description: Today, some wealthy families are using AI to educate their children. Meanwhile, Midjourney is seeking details on Hollywood's AI usage. Alibaba bans employees from using Claude Code, and the fanfiction community faces new AI-related conflicts.
